plugin.name: Hold B = Sprint (CCS LAYOUT 402)
plugin.description:
Replaces Authoria's stock controlmaps with Complete Controller Setup's own LAYOUT 402 - identical to the list's layout except: Sprint = hold B, Sneak = L3 click, Auto-Move = B+L3.
Dodge: tap B = dodge, hold B = sprint, and the six B-combos (Favorites, Wait, Quick menus) can never fire a dodge. This is the variant the fix was built and play-tested on.
3.1.0: Toggle POV is taken off the gamepad in BOTH controlmap files (text and binary), so R3 is True Directional Movement's lock-on only and never the vanilla POV toggle. POV stays on keyboard F (and the DLL's first-person block swallows even that unless you allow it in Padborn.json).

plugin.name: Keep Authoria's layout (LAYOUT 406)
plugin.description:
Installs no controlmaps - Complete Controller Setup's stock files keep winning, so every button stays exactly where Authoria shipped it: Sprint = press L3, Sneak = A+L3, Auto-Move = L3+R3.
Dodge stays on PRESS B, exactly as the list author configured it (iDodgeKey = 277). The only change is that the author's own setting now actually applies: the list's file starts with a UTF-8 BOM that silently breaks it, so saves were running the addon's factory default instead. A patched MCM script re-applies B on every load, so new AND existing saves work with zero setup. Authored quirk kept with it: pressing B while moving dodges - including inside B-combos.
On a layout that is neither 406 nor 402 (you reinstalled CCS with your own answers), pick this one - it touches no controlmaps, so it fits any layout.

plugin.name: Off (recommended)
plugin.description: Sprint rescue stays disabled. Pick this unless your sprint presses are being eaten. Everything else (Gamepad++ fixes, D-pad gestures, OStim controller layer, glyph bar, layout choice) works normally.

plugin.name: On
plugin.description: Enables the hold-to-sprint rescue: re-sets the sprint flag when a sprint press held past 0.3 s gets eaten by another mod (seen with Classic Sprinting Redone + TK Dodge RE Addon together). Experimental - confirmed on one setup so far. You can flip it later in SKSE/Plugins/Padborn.json ("sprint": { "enabled": true }).
